tasks.command: git status --short; git branch --show-current; git remote -v

tasks.command: git status --short; git branch --show-current; git remote -v

tasks.label: git-ahead-check
tasks.command: git status -sb; git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; git rev-parse HEAD; git log --oneline --decorate -n 3

tasks.label: deployment-files-check
tasks.command: if (Test-Path .github/workflows) { Get-ChildItem .github/workflows -Name } else { Write-Output "no-github-workflows" }; if (Test-Path vercel.json) { Write-Output "vercel" } else { Write-Output "no-vercel" }; if (Test-Path netlify.toml) { Write-Output "netlify" } else { Write-Output "no-netlify" }; if (Test-Path CNAME) { Write-Output "cname"; Get-Content CNAME }

tasks.label: post-push-status
tasks.command: git status --short; git status -sb; git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; git rev-parse HEAD

tasks.label: readd-required-article-files
tasks.command: git add blog/how-to-avoid-california-wage-and-hour-violations.html blog.html sitemap.xml; git status --short
